metadata.title: LearningO - Science / Speak
metadata.subject: Science
metadata.generated_for: Children with dyslexia and other learning differences, approx. ages 5-10
design_principles: Every question is scored by speech recognition against expected_keywords, not a single fixed transcript, so natural phrasing is accepted.
The module climbs from simple echo and naming to talking through a full scientific investigation aloud, the deepest test of understanding.
speech_scoring.sample_answer shows one good answer for engineering/QA reference; expected_keywords define what actually triggers credit.
Three difficulty bands rotate inside every type: easy for fluency, medium for the learning edge, happy for pure joy.
This module has no reading or writing load at all, so it can reveal a child's true scientific reasoning independent of literacy skill.
Feedback praises the process, never the child's intelligence.
Question-generation and full-investigation items (13, 15) are scored for genuine scientific thinking shown, not a single correct string.
Safety, honesty and help-seeking items carry a mastery_weight above 1.0 so they surface in reports even when accuracy overall is high.

tts_guidance.note: Read audio_text exactly as written when read-aloud support is used. For sequence and multi-select items, pause 500ms between listed items.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: reproducing a heard science word accurately
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Baseline articulation check for science vocabulary specifically, isolating pronunciation from meaning.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: retrieving a spoken science label for a known concept
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Pure word-finding with no reading or listening involved - isolates science vocabulary retrieval itself.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: producing a known animal sound in response to a named animal
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Playful oral science content connecting vocabulary directly to auditory-motor production.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: decoding and speaking a printed science word
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Direct fluency check for subject-specific vocabulary, which often uses less familiar spelling patterns.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: reading a connected science sentence aloud with reasonable flow
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Shows whether single-word science vocabulary decoding holds together across a full sentence.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: retrieving and speaking a known science fact without prompting for a specific one
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Open factual recall shows what a child genuinely knows and can express, not just what they can select.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: naming a category aloud and justifying the classification
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Combines classification with spoken reasoning - the 'why' matters as much as the category itself.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: generating original spoken description of a scene using specific science vocabulary
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether science vocabulary transfers into natural, unprompted spoken description.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: holding two items in mind and speaking the comparison result
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Oral version of comparative science reasoning, testing judgement without any visual symbols to lean on.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: producing a spoken retelling with correct process order
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: The oral equivalent of written sequencing tasks, without any reading or writing load at all.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: using existing knowledge to predict an outcome aloud
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Oral prediction removes the writing barrier, revealing predictive reasoning independent of literacy skill.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: verbalising both an effect and the underlying reason for it
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: A step beyond simple prediction - explaining the mechanism, not just the outcome.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: producing a genuine, answerable question about a science topic
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Question-generation is a core scientific skill, distinct from answering - the seed of all real investigation.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: describing a method for testing a stated question
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether the idea of a fair test can be applied and spoken, not just recognised in someone else's description.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: producing an original, extended spoken account of a full scientific inquiry
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: The ceiling task of the module - a full spoken investigation, the destination every other Speak type builds toward.

difficulty_band.easy: Consolidation. Child should succeed ~90% of the time. Builds fluency and confidence.
difficulty_band.medium: Learning edge. Target ~65-75% success. This is where growth data lives.
difficulty_band.happy: Pure joy question. Near-certain success, silly or warm content, low mastery weight. Placed to reset mood after effort and to keep the session feeling like play.

reporting_recipes.skill_profile: Group accuracy by academic.skill and cognition.process to find the child's cognitive shape (e.g. strong discriminate / weak sequence).
reporting_recipes.life_skill_radar: Group accuracy by life_skill.domain across all subjects to build a 14-spoke life-skill radar chart per child.
reporting_recipes.dyslexia_error_map: Count wrong answers by distractor_insight value, not just by question. The distractor tells you WHY, so one wrong tap becomes a diagnosis.
reporting_recipes.attention_curve: Plot time_to_first_touch and accuracy against telemetry.session_position to find the child's real attention span, then cap session length there.
reporting_recipes.working_memory_ceiling: Accuracy vs cognition.working_memory_load. The load level where accuracy drops below 60% is the child's current WM ceiling - never exceed it during teaching.
reporting_recipes.confidence_calibration: Compare the wellbeing.confidence_prompt answer with actual correctness. Confident+wrong = misconception to correct. Unsure+right = needs reassurance, not more teaching.
reporting_recipes.impulsivity_index: Wrong answers where time_to_first_touch < 25% of expected_response_time_ms. High index means teach 'wait and think', not more content.
reporting_recipes.persistence_index: Retry rate and abandon rate on medium-band items. Falling persistence over weeks is an early wellbeing flag.
reporting_recipes.mood_trend: Track emotion_checkin responses over sessions. Two sad check-ins in a row should lower difficulty automatically for the next session.
reporting_recipes.personality_map: Aggregate personality_signal outcomes to describe tendencies (e.g. cautious, highly pro-social, low help-seeking) for the parent report.

wellbeing_rules: No question ever shows a countdown clock. Speed is rewarded, never punished.
Feedback praises the process ('you listened right to the end'), never the child's intelligence.
After two wrong answers the app shows how it works instead of asking again.
A happy-band question follows any run of three errors.
Every safety and help-seeking question points the child towards a trusted grown-up.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Listen. Say the science word back.
hints: Say exactly what you heard.
questions.worked_example: Listen once more, then copy exactly what you hear.

feedback.correct: Butterfly - said clearly. 🦋
feedback.incorrect: Listen once more and copy the word exactly.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Noticing small creatures around you is where real curiosity starts.

analysis.primary_construct: reproducing a heard science word accurately
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Baseline articulation check for science vocabulary specifically, isolating pronunciation from meaning.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Consistent substitution of one sound for another in a science word points to a specific articulation pattern worth noting.
analysis.parent_note: A simple echo check that science words are being produced clearly, not just heard correctly.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Model the science word slowly, exaggerating any tricky sound, then ask for an echo.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: butterfly

es.instruction: Escucha. Repite la palabra de ciencias.
hints: Di exactamente lo que escuchaste.
es.worked_example: Escucha una vez más y luego repite exactamente lo que oyes.

feedback.correct: Mariposa - dicho con claridad. 🦋
feedback.incorrect: Escucha una vez más y repite la palabra exactamente.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: mariposa

fr.instruction: Écoute. Redis le mot scientifique.
hints: Dis exactement ce que tu as entendu.

feedback.incorrect: Écoute encore une fois et répète le mot exactement.
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

hints: Diga exatamente o que você ouviu.

hints: Ripeti esattamente quello che hai sentito.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Sprich das Fachwort nach.
hints: Sag genau das, was du gehört hast.

feedback.incorrect: Höre noch einmal zu und sprich das Wort genau nach.

nl.instruction: Zeg wat je voorspelt dat er gaat gebeuren.
nl.prompt: Een plant wordt twee weken in een volledig donkere kast gehouden.
hints: Wat hebben planten nodig dat een donkere kast niet geeft?
nl.worked_example: Denk aan wat je al weet. Zeg je beste gok, en waarom.

feedback.correct: Hij zal waarschijnlijk verwelken - een goed beredeneerde voorspelling. 🥀
feedback.incorrect: Denk aan wat een plant mist in het donker, en zeg dan je voorspelling en waarom.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Hij zal waarschijnlijk verwelken of bleek worden, omdat hij zonlicht nodig heeft.

ru.instruction: Скажи, что, по-твоему, произойдёт.
ru.prompt: Растение держат в полностью тёмном шкафу две недели.
hints: Что нужно растениям, чего тёмный шкаф не даёт?
ru.worked_example: Подумай о том, что ты уже знаешь. Скажи свою лучшую догадку и почему.

feedback.correct: Оно, вероятно, завянет — хорошо обоснованное предсказание. 🥀
feedback.incorrect: Подумай, чего не хватает растению в темноте, затем скажи своё предсказание и почему.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Оно, вероятно, завянет или побледнеет, потому что ему нужен солнечный свет.

tr.prompt: Bir bitki iki hafta boyunca tamamen karanlık bir dolapta tutuluyor.
hints: Bitkilerin ihtiyacı olan ama karanlık bir dolabın sağlamadığı şey nedir?
tr.worked_example: Zaten bildiğin şeyi düşün. En iyi tahminini ve nedenini söyle.

feedback.correct: Muhtemelen solacak - iyi akıl yürütülmüş bir tahmin. 🥀
feedback.incorrect: Bir bitkinin karanlıkta neyi kaçırdığını düşün, sonra tahminini ve nedenini söyle.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Muhtemelen solacak veya soluklaşacak, çünkü güneş ışığına ihtiyacı var.

zh.instruction: 说一说你预测会发生什么。
zh.prompt: 一株植物被放在完全黑暗的柜子里两个星期。
hints: 植物需要什么,而黑暗的柜子无法提供?
zh.worked_example: 想一想你已经知道的知识。说出你最好的猜测,以及原因。

feedback.correct: 它可能会枯萎——这是一个推理合理的预测。🥀
feedback.incorrect: 想一想植物在黑暗中缺少了什么,然后说出你的预测和原因。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 它可能会枯萎或变黄,因为它需要阳光。

ja.instruction: 何が起こるか予想して言おう。
ja.prompt: 植物を完全に真っ暗な戸棚の中に2週間入れておく。
hints: 真っ暗な戸棚にはない、植物が必要とするものは何?
ja.worked_example: すでに知っていることを考えよう。一番良さそうな予想と、その理由を言おう。

feedback.correct: たぶんしおれるよ。よく考えられた予想だね。🥀
feedback.incorrect: 暗い場所で植物に足りないものを考えて、予想とその理由を言おう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: たぶんしおれたり、色が薄くなったりするよ、日光が必要だから。

ko.instruction: 무엇이 일어날지 예측해서 말해보세요.
ko.prompt: 식물을 완전히 어두운 찬장에 2주 동안 둡니다.
hints: 어두운 찬장에서 식물에게 없는 것은 무엇일까요?
ko.worked_example: 이미 알고 있는 것을 생각해보세요. 가장 그럴듯한 추측과 그 이유를 말해보세요.

feedback.correct: 아마 시들 거예요 - 잘 추론한 예측이에요. 🥀
feedback.incorrect: 어둠 속에서 식물에게 부족한 것을 생각하고, 예측과 이유를 말해보세요.
feedback.second_try: 함께 해볼까요 - 어떻게 하는지 지켜보세요.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 식물은 햇빛이 필요하기 때문에 아마 시들거나 색이 바랠 거예요.

id.instruction: Ucapkan apa yang menurutmu akan terjadi.
id.prompt: Sebuah tumbuhan disimpan di dalam lemari yang benar-benar gelap selama dua minggu.
hints: Apa yang dibutuhkan tumbuhan yang tidak disediakan oleh lemari gelap?
id.worked_example: Pikirkan apa yang sudah kamu ketahui. Ucapkan tebakan terbaikmu, dan alasannya.

feedback.correct: Tumbuhannya mungkin akan layu - prediksi yang beralasan dengan baik. 🥀
feedback.incorrect: Pikirkan apa yang tidak dimiliki tumbuhan dalam kegelapan, lalu ucapkan prediksimu dan alasannya.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Tumbuhannya mungkin akan layu atau menjadi pucat, karena membutuhkan sinar matahari.

vi.instruction: Nói điều bạn đoán sẽ xảy ra.
vi.prompt: Một cây được giữ trong một cái tủ hoàn toàn tối trong hai tuần.
hints: Cây cần điều gì mà một cái tủ tối không cung cấp được?
vi.worked_example: Nghĩ về điều bạn đã biết. Nói ra dự đoán tốt nhất của bạn, và vì sao.

feedback.correct: Nó có thể sẽ héo đi - một dự đoán có lý do rõ ràng. 🥀
feedback.incorrect: Nghĩ xem cây đang thiếu điều gì trong bóng tối, rồi nói dự đoán của bạn và vì sao.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Nó có thể sẽ héo hoặc nhạt màu đi, vì nó cần ánh sáng mặt trời.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Say what you predict will happen.
questions.prompt: Two identical ice cubes - one in a warm room, one in the fridge.
hints: Which environment is warmer, and what does warmth do to ice?
questions.worked_example: Think about what you already know. Say your best guess, and why.

feedback.correct: The warm room one melts faster - a well-reasoned, comparative prediction. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Think about which environment is warmer, and what that means for melting speed.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Comparing two setups with just one difference is the heart of a fair test.

analysis.primary_construct: using existing knowledge to predict an outcome aloud
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Oral prediction removes the writing barrier, revealing predictive reasoning independent of literacy skill.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A prediction given with no reasoning attached shows the idea is there but the justification habit isn't yet.
analysis.parent_note: Ask why after any prediction, gently and often - it builds this exact reasoning muscle.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Predict outcomes together before checking, during any hands-on activity.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: The one in the warm room will melt faster, because warmth speeds up melting.

es.instruction: Di qué predices que va a pasar.
es.prompt: Dos cubos de hielo idénticos - uno en una habitación cálida, otro en la nevera.
hints: ¿Qué ambiente es más cálido, y qué le hace el calor al hielo?
es.worked_example: Piensa en lo que ya sabes. Di tu mejor suposición, y por qué.

feedback.correct: El de la habitación cálida se derrite más rápido - una predicción comparativa bien razonada. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Piensa en qué ambiente es más cálido, y qué significa eso para la velocidad de derretimiento.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: El de la habitación cálida se derretirá más rápido, porque el calor acelera el derretimiento.

fr.instruction: Dis ce que tu penses qu'il va se passer.
fr.prompt: Deux glaçons identiques - l'un dans une pièce chaude, l'autre dans le réfrigérateur.
hints: Quel environnement est le plus chaud, et que fait la chaleur à la glace ?
fr.worked_example: Pense à ce que tu sais déjà. Dis ta meilleure hypothèse, et pourquoi.

feedback.correct: Celui de la pièce chaude fond plus vite - une prédiction comparative bien raisonnée. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Pense à quel environnement est le plus chaud, et ce que ça signifie pour la vitesse de fonte.
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Celui de la pièce chaude va fondre plus vite, parce que la chaleur accélère la fonte.

pt.instruction: Diga o que você prevê que vai acontecer.
pt.prompt: Dois cubos de gelo idênticos - um em uma sala quente, outro na geladeira.
hints: Qual ambiente é mais quente, e o que o calor faz com o gelo?
pt.worked_example: Pense no que você já sabe. Diga seu melhor palpite, e por quê.

feedback.correct: O da sala quente derrete mais rápido - uma previsão comparativa bem fundamentada. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Pense em qual ambiente é mais quente, e o que isso significa para a velocidade de derretimento.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: O que está na sala quente vai derreter mais rápido, porque o calor acelera o derretimento.

it.instruction: Dì cosa prevedi che accadrà.
it.prompt: Due cubetti di ghiaccio identici - uno in una stanza calda, uno nel frigorifero.
hints: Quale ambiente è più caldo, e cosa fa il calore al ghiaccio?
it.worked_example: Pensa a quello che già sai. Dì la tua ipotesi migliore, e perché.

feedback.correct: Quello nella stanza calda si scioglie più velocemente - una previsione ben ragionata e comparativa. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Pensa a quale ambiente è più caldo, e cosa significa questo per la velocità di scioglimento.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come funziona.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Quello nella stanza calda si scioglierà più velocemente, perché il calore accelera lo scioglimento.

de.instruction: Sag, was du vorhersagst, dass passieren wird.
de.prompt: Zwei gleiche Eiswürfel – einer in einem warmen Zimmer, einer im Kühlschrank.
hints: Welche Umgebung ist wärmer, und was macht Wärme mit Eis?
de.worked_example: Denk an das, was du schon weißt. Sag deine beste Vermutung, und warum.

feedback.correct: Der im warmen Zimmer schmilzt schneller – eine gut begründete, vergleichende Vorhersage. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Denk darüber nach, welche Umgebung wärmer ist, und was das für die Schmelzgeschwindigkeit bedeutet.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Der im warmen Zimmer wird schneller schmelzen, weil Wärme das Schmelzen beschleunigt.

nl.instruction: Zeg wat je voorspelt dat er gaat gebeuren.
nl.prompt: Twee identieke ijsblokjes - één in een warme kamer, één in de koelkast.
hints: Welke omgeving is warmer, en wat doet warmte met ijs?
nl.worked_example: Denk aan wat je al weet. Zeg je beste gok, en waarom.

feedback.correct: Het blokje in de warme kamer smelt sneller - een goed beredeneerde, vergelijkende voorspelling. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Denk aan welke omgeving warmer is, en wat dat betekent voor de smeltsnelheid.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Het blokje in de warme kamer smelt sneller, omdat warmte het smelten versnelt.

ru.instruction: Скажи, что, по-твоему, произойдёт.
ru.prompt: Два одинаковых кубика льда — один в тёплой комнате, другой в холодильнике.
hints: Какая среда теплее, и что тепло делает со льдом?
ru.worked_example: Подумай о том, что ты уже знаешь. Скажи свою лучшую догадку и почему.

feedback.correct: Тот, что в тёплой комнате, растает быстрее — хорошо обоснованное, сравнительное предсказание. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Подумай, какая среда теплее, и что это значит для скорости таяния.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Тот, что в тёплой комнате, растает быстрее, потому что тепло ускоряет таяние.

tr.prompt: İki aynı buz küpü - biri sıcak bir odada, biri buzdolabında.
hints: Hangi ortam daha sıcak ve sıcaklık buza ne yapar?
tr.worked_example: Zaten bildiğin şeyi düşün. En iyi tahminini ve nedenini söyle.

feedback.correct: Sıcak odadaki daha hızlı erir - iyi akıl yürütülmüş, karşılaştırmalı bir tahmin. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Hangi ortamın daha sıcak olduğunu ve bunun erime hızı için ne anlama geldiğini düşün.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Sıcak odadaki daha hızlı eriyecek, çünkü sıcaklık erimeyi hızlandırır.

zh.instruction: 说一说你预测会发生什么。
zh.prompt: 两块完全一样的冰块——一块放在温暖的房间里,一块放在冰箱里。
hints: 哪个环境更暖?温暖会对冰产生什么影响?
zh.worked_example: 想一想你已经知道的知识。说出你最好的猜测,以及原因。

feedback.correct: 房间里的那块会更快融化——这是一个推理合理的比较性预测。🧊
feedback.incorrect: 想一想哪个环境更暖,这对融化速度意味着什么。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 房间里的那块会更快融化,因为温暖会加快融化速度。

ja.instruction: 何が起こるか予想して言おう。
ja.prompt: 同じ氷を2つ。1つは暖かい部屋に、もう1つは冷蔵庫に。
hints: どちらの場所が暖かくて、暖かさは氷に何をする?
ja.worked_example: すでに知っていることを考えよう。一番良さそうな予想と、その理由を言おう。

feedback.correct: 暖かい部屋の氷の方が速く溶けるよ。よく考えられた、比べる予想だね。🧊
feedback.incorrect: どちらの場所が暖かいか、それが溶ける速さにどう関係するか考えよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 暖かい部屋の氷の方が速く溶けるよ、暖かさは溶けるのを速くするから。

ko.instruction: 무엇이 일어날지 예측해서 말해보세요.
ko.prompt: 똑같은 얼음 두 조각 - 하나는 따뜻한 방에, 하나는 냉장고에 둡니다.
hints: 어느 환경이 더 따뜻하고, 따뜻함이 얼음에 무엇을 할까요?
ko.worked_example: 이미 알고 있는 것을 생각해보세요. 가장 그럴듯한 추측과 그 이유를 말해보세요.

feedback.correct: 따뜻한 방에 있는 것이 더 빨리 녹을 거예요 - 잘 추론한 비교 예측이에요. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: 어느 환경이 더 따뜻한지, 그것이 녹는 속도에 어떤 의미인지 생각해보세요.
feedback.second_try: 함께 해볼까요 - 어떻게 하는지 지켜보세요.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 따뜻함이 녹는 속도를 높이기 때문에 따뜻한 방에 있는 것이 더 빨리 녹을 거예요.

id.instruction: Ucapkan apa yang menurutmu akan terjadi.
id.prompt: Dua kubus es yang identik - satu di ruangan yang hangat, satu di dalam kulkas.
hints: Lingkungan mana yang lebih hangat, dan apa yang dilakukan kehangatan pada es?
id.worked_example: Pikirkan apa yang sudah kamu ketahui. Ucapkan tebakan terbaikmu, dan alasannya.

feedback.correct: Es di ruangan hangat mencair lebih cepat - prediksi perbandingan yang beralasan dengan baik. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Pikirkan lingkungan mana yang lebih hangat, dan apa artinya bagi kecepatan mencair.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Es yang di ruangan hangat akan mencair lebih cepat, karena kehangatan mempercepat proses mencair.

vi.instruction: Nói điều bạn đoán sẽ xảy ra.
vi.prompt: Hai viên đá giống nhau - một để trong phòng ấm, một để trong tủ lạnh.
hints: Môi trường nào ấm hơn, và sự ấm làm gì với đá?
vi.worked_example: Nghĩ về điều bạn đã biết. Nói ra dự đoán tốt nhất của bạn, và vì sao.

feedback.correct: Viên đá trong phòng ấm sẽ tan nhanh hơn - một dự đoán so sánh có lý do rõ ràng. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Nghĩ xem môi trường nào ấm hơn, và điều đó có nghĩa gì cho tốc độ tan chảy.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Viên đá trong phòng ấm sẽ tan nhanh hơn, vì sự ấm làm tăng tốc độ tan chảy.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Say what you predict will happen.
questions.prompt: A caterpillar has eaten a huge amount of leaves for weeks.
hints: What is all that eating usually preparing a caterpillar for?
questions.worked_example: Think about what you already know. Say your best guess, and why.

feedback.correct: It will build a cocoon and become a butterfly - a well-reasoned prediction. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Think about what all that eating usually leads to, then say your prediction.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.hidden_lesson: All that eating stores up the energy needed for the huge change ahead.

analysis.primary_construct: using existing knowledge to predict an outcome aloud
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Oral prediction removes the writing barrier, revealing predictive reasoning independent of literacy skill.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A prediction given with no reasoning attached shows the idea is there but the justification habit isn't yet.
analysis.parent_note: Ask why after any prediction, gently and often - it builds this exact reasoning muscle.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Predict outcomes together before checking, during any hands-on activity.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: It will probably build a cocoon soon and change into a butterfly.

es.instruction: Di qué predices que va a pasar.
es.prompt: Una oruga ha comido una enorme cantidad de hojas durante semanas.
hints: ¿Para qué suele prepararse una oruga con toda esa comida?
es.worked_example: Piensa en lo que ya sabes. Di tu mejor suposición, y por qué.

feedback.correct: Formará un capullo y se convertirá en mariposa - una predicción bien razonada. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Piensa en a qué suele llevar toda esa comida, y luego di tu predicción.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Probablemente formará un capullo pronto y se convertirá en mariposa.

fr.instruction: Dis ce que tu penses qu'il va se passer.
fr.prompt: Une chenille a mangé une énorme quantité de feuilles pendant des semaines.
hints: À quoi tout ce festin prépare-t-il généralement une chenille ?
fr.worked_example: Pense à ce que tu sais déjà. Dis ta meilleure hypothèse, et pourquoi.

feedback.correct: Elle va fabriquer un cocon et devenir un papillon - une prédiction bien raisonnée. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Pense à ce que tout ce festin entraîne généralement, puis dis ta prédiction.
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Elle va probablement fabriquer un cocon bientôt et se transformer en papillon.

pt.instruction: Diga o que você prevê que vai acontecer.
pt.prompt: Uma lagarta comeu uma quantidade enorme de folhas durante semanas.
hints: Para que essa comilança toda costuma preparar uma lagarta?
pt.worked_example: Pense no que você já sabe. Diga seu melhor palpite, e por quê.

feedback.correct: Vai construir um casulo e se tornar uma borboleta - uma previsão bem fundamentada. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Pense no que essa comilança toda costuma levar, depois diga sua previsão.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Ela provavelmente vai construir um casulo em breve e se transformar em borboleta.

it.instruction: Dì cosa prevedi che accadrà.
it.prompt: Un bruco ha mangiato una quantità enorme di foglie per settimane.
hints: A cosa prepara di solito tutto quel mangiare un bruco?
it.worked_example: Pensa a quello che già sai. Dì la tua ipotesi migliore, e perché.

feedback.correct: Costruirà un bozzolo e diventerà una farfalla - una previsione ben ragionata. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Pensa a cosa porta di solito tutto quel mangiare, poi dì la tua previsione.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come funziona.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Probabilmente costruirà presto un bozzolo e si trasformerà in una farfalla.

de.instruction: Sag, was du vorhersagst, dass passieren wird.
de.prompt: Eine Raupe hat wochenlang eine riesige Menge an Blättern gefressen.
hints: Worauf bereitet all dieses Fressen eine Raupe normalerweise vor?
de.worked_example: Denk an das, was du schon weißt. Sag deine beste Vermutung, und warum.

feedback.correct: Sie wird einen Kokon bauen und zu einem Schmetterling werden – eine gut begründete Vorhersage. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Denk darüber nach, wozu all dieses Fressen normalerweise führt, und sag dann deine Vorhersage.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Sie wird wahrscheinlich bald einen Kokon bauen und sich in einen Schmetterling verwandeln.

nl.instruction: Zeg wat je voorspelt dat er gaat gebeuren.
nl.prompt: Een rups heeft wekenlang enorm veel bladeren gegeten.
hints: Waarop bereidt al dat eten een rups meestal voor?
nl.worked_example: Denk aan wat je al weet. Zeg je beste gok, en waarom.

feedback.correct: Hij zal een cocon maken en een vlinder worden - een goed beredeneerde voorspelling. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Denk aan waartoe al dat eten meestal leidt, en zeg dan je voorspelling.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Hij zal waarschijnlijk binnenkort een cocon maken en veranderen in een vlinder.

ru.instruction: Скажи, что, по-твоему, произойдёт.
ru.prompt: Гусеница несколько недель ела огромное количество листьев.
hints: К чему обычно готовит гусеницу всё это поедание?
ru.worked_example: Подумай о том, что ты уже знаешь. Скажи свою лучшую догадку и почему.

feedback.correct: Она построит кокон и превратится в бабочку — хорошо обоснованное предсказание. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Подумай, к чему обычно приводит всё это поедание, затем скажи своё предсказание.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Она, вероятно, скоро построит кокон и превратится в бабочку.

tr.prompt: Bir tırtıl haftalarca çok büyük miktarda yaprak yedi.
hints: Bütün o yemek bir tırtılı genellikle neye hazırlar?
tr.worked_example: Zaten bildiğin şeyi düşün. En iyi tahminini ve nedenini söyle.

feedback.correct: Bir koza yapıp kelebeğe dönüşecek - iyi akıl yürütülmüş bir tahmin. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Bütün o yemenin genellikle neye yol açtığını düşün, sonra tahminini söyle.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Muhtemelen yakında bir koza yapacak ve kelebeğe dönüşecek.

zh.instruction: 说一说你预测会发生什么。
zh.prompt: 一只毛毛虫已经连续几个星期吃了大量的叶子。
hints: 这么多的进食通常是为了让毛毛虫准备做什么?
zh.worked_example: 想一想你已经知道的知识。说出你最好的猜测,以及原因。

feedback.correct: 它会结蛹并变成蝴蝶——这是一个推理合理的预测。🐛
feedback.incorrect: 想一想这么多的进食通常会导致什么,然后说出你的预测。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 它可能很快就会结蛹,然后变成蝴蝶。

ja.instruction: 何が起こるか予想して言おう。
ja.prompt: 幼虫が何週間もたくさんの葉を食べ続けている。
hints: そんなにたくさん食べるのは、ふつう何のための準備?
ja.worked_example: すでに知っていることを考えよう。一番良さそうな予想と、その理由を言おう。

feedback.correct: さなぎを作って、ちょうになるよ。よく考えられた予想だね。🐛
feedback.incorrect: そんなに食べることが、ふつう何につながるか考えて、予想を言おう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: もうすぐさなぎを作って、ちょうに変わるよ。

ko.instruction: 무엇이 일어날지 예측해서 말해보세요.
ko.prompt: 애벌레가 몇 주 동안 아주 많은 잎을 먹었습니다.
hints: 그렇게 많이 먹는 것은 보통 애벌레에게 무엇을 준비시킬까요?
ko.worked_example: 이미 알고 있는 것을 생각해보세요. 가장 그럴듯한 추측과 그 이유를 말해보세요.

feedback.correct: 고치를 만들고 나비가 될 거예요 - 잘 추론한 예측이에요. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: 그렇게 많이 먹는 것이 보통 무엇으로 이어지는지 생각하고 예측을 말해보세요.
feedback.second_try: 함께 해볼까요 - 어떻게 하는지 지켜보세요.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 아마 곧 고치를 만들고 나비로 변할 거예요.

id.instruction: Ucapkan apa yang menurutmu akan terjadi.
id.prompt: Seekor ulat telah memakan banyak sekali daun selama beberapa minggu.
hints: Untuk apa biasanya semua makan itu menyiapkan seekor ulat?
id.worked_example: Pikirkan apa yang sudah kamu ketahui. Ucapkan tebakan terbaikmu, dan alasannya.

feedback.correct: Ulatnya akan membuat kepompong dan menjadi kupu-kupu - prediksi yang beralasan dengan baik. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Pikirkan ke mana biasanya semua makan itu akan berujung, lalu ucapkan prediksimu.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Ulatnya mungkin akan segera membuat kepompong dan berubah menjadi kupu-kupu.

vi.instruction: Nói điều bạn đoán sẽ xảy ra.
vi.prompt: Một con sâu bướm đã ăn rất nhiều lá trong nhiều tuần.
hints: Việc ăn nhiều như vậy thường chuẩn bị cho sâu bướm điều gì?
vi.worked_example: Nghĩ về điều bạn đã biết. Nói ra dự đoán tốt nhất của bạn, và vì sao.

feedback.correct: Nó sẽ tạo kén và trở thành bướm - một dự đoán có lý do rõ ràng. 🐛
feedback.incorrect: Nghĩ xem việc ăn nhiều như vậy thường dẫn đến điều gì, rồi nói dự đoán của bạn.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Nó có thể sẽ sớm tạo kén và biến thành bướm.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Say what you predict will happen.
questions.prompt: A lunchbox with meat inside is left in a hot car all day.
hints: What do warmth and time usually do to food safety?
questions.worked_example: Think about what you already know. Say your best guess, and why.

feedback.correct: It might not be safe anymore - a well-reasoned, safety-relevant prediction. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Think about what warmth and time usually do to food safety, then say your prediction.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.hidden_lesson: This exact chain of reasoning is why food left in warm places for a long time can become unsafe.

analysis.primary_construct: using existing knowledge to predict an outcome aloud
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Oral prediction removes the writing barrier, revealing predictive reasoning independent of literacy skill.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A prediction given with no reasoning attached shows the idea is there but the justification habit isn't yet.
analysis.parent_note: Ask why after any prediction, gently and often - it builds this exact reasoning muscle.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Predict outcomes together before checking, during any hands-on activity.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: It might not be safe to eat anymore, because warmth lets bacteria grow.

es.instruction: Di qué predices que va a pasar.
es.prompt: Una lonchera con carne dentro se deja en un auto caliente todo el día.
hints: ¿Qué suelen hacer el calor y el tiempo con la seguridad de la comida?
es.worked_example: Piensa en lo que ya sabes. Di tu mejor suposición, y por qué.

feedback.correct: Puede que ya no sea segura - una predicción bien razonada y relevante para la seguridad. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Piensa en qué suelen hacer el calor y el tiempo con la seguridad de la comida, y luego di tu predicción.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Puede que ya no sea segura para comer, porque el calor hace crecer a las bacterias.

fr.instruction: Dis ce que tu penses qu'il va se passer.
fr.prompt: Une boîte à déjeuner avec de la viande dedans est laissée dans une voiture chaude toute la journée.
hints: Que font généralement la chaleur et le temps à la sécurité des aliments ?
fr.worked_example: Pense à ce que tu sais déjà. Dis ta meilleure hypothèse, et pourquoi.

feedback.correct: Elle pourrait ne plus être sûre à manger - une prédiction bien raisonnée, pertinente pour la sécurité. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Pense à ce que la chaleur et le temps font généralement à la sécurité des aliments, puis dis ta prédiction.
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Elle pourrait ne plus être sûre à manger, parce que la chaleur permet aux bactéries de se développer.

pt.instruction: Diga o que você prevê que vai acontecer.
pt.prompt: Uma lancheira com carne dentro fica em um carro quente o dia todo.
hints: O que o calor e o tempo costumam fazer com a segurança da comida?
pt.worked_example: Pense no que você já sabe. Diga seu melhor palpite, e por quê.

feedback.correct: Pode não estar mais segura - uma previsão bem fundamentada e relevante para a segurança. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Pense no que o calor e o tempo costumam fazer com a segurança da comida, depois diga sua previsão.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Pode não ser mais segura para comer, porque o calor deixa as bactérias se multiplicarem.

it.instruction: Dì cosa prevedi che accadrà.
it.prompt: Un porta pranzo con dentro della carne viene lasciato in un'auto calda per tutto il giorno.
hints: Cosa fanno di solito il calore e il tempo alla sicurezza del cibo?
it.worked_example: Pensa a quello che già sai. Dì la tua ipotesi migliore, e perché.

feedback.correct: Potrebbe non essere più sicuro - una previsione ben ragionata e rilevante per la sicurezza. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Pensa a cosa fanno di solito il calore e il tempo alla sicurezza del cibo, poi dì la tua previsione.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come funziona.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Potrebbe non essere più sicuro da mangiare, perché il calore permette ai batteri di crescere.

de.instruction: Sag, was du vorhersagst, dass passieren wird.
de.prompt: Eine Lunchbox mit Fleisch darin wird den ganzen Tag in einem heißen Auto liegen gelassen.
hints: Was machen Wärme und Zeit normalerweise mit der Lebensmittelsicherheit?
de.worked_example: Denk an das, was du schon weißt. Sag deine beste Vermutung, und warum.

feedback.correct: Es könnte nicht mehr sicher sein – eine gut begründete, sicherheitsrelevante Vorhersage. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Denk darüber nach, was Wärme und Zeit normalerweise mit der Lebensmittelsicherheit machen, und sag dann deine Vorhersage.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Es könnte nicht mehr sicher zu essen sein, weil Wärme Bakterien wachsen lässt.

nl.instruction: Zeg wat je voorspelt dat er gaat gebeuren.
nl.prompt: Een lunchbox met vlees erin wordt een hele dag in een warme auto gelaten.
hints: Wat doen warmte en tijd meestal met voedselveiligheid?
nl.worked_example: Denk aan wat je al weet. Zeg je beste gok, en waarom.

feedback.correct: Het is misschien niet meer veilig - een goed beredeneerde, veiligheidsrelevante voorspelling. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Denk aan wat warmte en tijd meestal doen met voedselveiligheid, en zeg dan je voorspelling.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Het is misschien niet meer veilig om te eten, omdat warmte bacteriën laat groeien.

ru.instruction: Скажи, что, по-твоему, произойдёт.
ru.prompt: Ланч-бокс с мясом внутри оставляют в жаркой машине на весь день.
hints: Что обычно тепло и время делают с безопасностью еды?
ru.worked_example: Подумай о том, что ты уже знаешь. Скажи свою лучшую догадку и почему.

feedback.correct: Она может стать небезопасной — хорошо обоснованное предсказание, важное для безопасности. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Подумай, что обычно тепло и время делают с безопасностью еды, затем скажи своё предсказание.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Её может быть небезопасно есть, потому что тепло позволяет бактериям размножаться.

tr.prompt: İçinde et olan bir yemek kutusu bütün gün sıcak bir arabada bırakılıyor.
hints: Sıcaklık ve zaman genellikle gıda güvenliğine ne yapar?
tr.worked_example: Zaten bildiğin şeyi düşün. En iyi tahminini ve nedenini söyle.

feedback.correct: Artık güvenli olmayabilir - iyi akıl yürütülmüş, güvenlikle ilgili bir tahmin. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Sıcaklık ve zamanın genellikle gıda güvenliğine ne yaptığını düşün, sonra tahminini söyle.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Artık yemek için güvenli olmayabilir, çünkü sıcaklık bakterilerin çoğalmasına izin verir.

zh.instruction: 说一说你预测会发生什么。
zh.prompt: 一个装着肉的午餐盒被整天放在炎热的车里。
hints: 温度和时间通常会对食物的安全性产生什么影响?
zh.worked_example: 想一想你已经知道的知识。说出你最好的猜测,以及原因。

feedback.correct: 它可能已经不安全了——这是一个推理合理、与安全相关的预测。🍱
feedback.incorrect: 想一想温度和时间通常会对食物安全产生什么影响,然后说出你的预测。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 它可能已经不能安全食用了,因为温暖会让细菌繁殖。

ja.instruction: 何が起こるか予想して言おう。
ja.prompt: 肉の入ったお弁当箱を、一日中暑い車の中に置いておく。
hints: 暖かさと時間は、ふつう食べ物の安全性にどう関係する?
ja.worked_example: すでに知っていることを考えよう。一番良さそうな予想と、その理由を言おう。

feedback.correct: もう安全ではないかもしれないよ。よく考えられた、安全にかかわる予想だね。🍱
feedback.incorrect: 暖かさと時間が食べ物の安全性にどう関係するか考えて、予想を言おう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: もう食べるのに安全ではないかもしれないよ、暖かさで細菌が増えるから。

ko.instruction: 무엇이 일어날지 예측해서 말해보세요.
ko.prompt: 고기가 든 도시락을 더운 차 안에 하루 종일 둡니다.
hints: 따뜻함과 시간은 보통 음식의 안전에 무엇을 할까요?
ko.worked_example: 이미 알고 있는 것을 생각해보세요. 가장 그럴듯한 추측과 그 이유를 말해보세요.

feedback.correct: 더 이상 안전하지 않을 수도 있어요 - 잘 추론한, 안전과 관련된 예측이에요. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: 따뜻함과 시간이 음식 안전에 보통 무엇을 하는지 생각하고 예측을 말해보세요.
feedback.second_try: 함께 해볼까요 - 어떻게 하는지 지켜보세요.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 따뜻함이 세균을 자라게 하기 때문에 더 이상 먹기에 안전하지 않을 수도 있어요.

id.instruction: Ucapkan apa yang menurutmu akan terjadi.
id.prompt: Sebuah kotak makan berisi daging ditinggalkan di dalam mobil yang panas sepanjang hari.
hints: Apa yang biasanya dilakukan kehangatan dan waktu terhadap keamanan makanan?
id.worked_example: Pikirkan apa yang sudah kamu ketahui. Ucapkan tebakan terbaikmu, dan alasannya.

feedback.correct: Makanannya mungkin sudah tidak aman lagi - prediksi yang beralasan dan relevan dengan keamanan. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Pikirkan apa yang biasanya dilakukan kehangatan dan waktu terhadap keamanan makanan, lalu ucapkan prediksimu.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Makanannya mungkin sudah tidak aman untuk dimakan, karena kehangatan membuat bakteri tumbuh.

vi.instruction: Nói điều bạn đoán sẽ xảy ra.
vi.prompt: Một hộp cơm có thịt bên trong bị để trong xe nóng cả ngày.
hints: Sự ấm và thời gian thường ảnh hưởng gì đến độ an toàn của thực phẩm?
vi.worked_example: Nghĩ về điều bạn đã biết. Nói ra dự đoán tốt nhất của bạn, và vì sao.

feedback.correct: Nó có thể không còn an toàn nữa - một dự đoán có lý do rõ ràng, liên quan đến an toàn. 🍱
feedback.incorrect: Nghĩ xem sự ấm và thời gian thường ảnh hưởng gì đến độ an toàn của thực phẩm, rồi nói dự đoán của bạn.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Nó có thể không còn an toàn để ăn nữa, vì sự ấm khiến vi khuẩn phát triển.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Say what you predict will happen.
questions.prompt: A scientist adds special fertiliser to only one of two identical plants.
hints: What is fertiliser generally meant to help a plant do?
questions.worked_example: Think about what you already know. Say your best guess, and why.

feedback.correct: The fertilised plant might grow better - a well-reasoned prediction. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Think about what fertiliser is generally meant to help a plant do, then say your prediction.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.primary: Predicting outcomes of a fair test aloud
life_skill.hidden_lesson: Changing only one thing at a time is exactly what makes a test's results trustworthy.

analysis.primary_construct: using existing knowledge to predict an outcome aloud
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Oral prediction removes the writing barrier, revealing predictive reasoning independent of literacy skill.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A prediction given with no reasoning attached shows the idea is there but the justification habit isn't yet.
analysis.parent_note: Ask why after any prediction, gently and often - it builds this exact reasoning muscle.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Predict outcomes together before checking, during any hands-on activity.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: The fertilised plant might grow taller or healthier than the other one.

es.instruction: Di qué predices que va a pasar.
es.prompt: Un científico añade fertilizante especial solo a una de dos plantas idénticas.
hints: ¿Para qué sirve generalmente el fertilizante en una planta?
es.worked_example: Piensa en lo que ya sabes. Di tu mejor suposición, y por qué.

feedback.correct: La planta fertilizada podría crecer mejor - una predicción bien razonada. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Piensa en para qué sirve generalmente el fertilizante en una planta, y luego di tu predicción.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: La planta fertilizada podría crecer más alta o más sana que la otra.

fr.instruction: Dis ce que tu penses qu'il va se passer.
fr.prompt: Un scientifique ajoute un engrais spécial à une seule de deux plantes identiques.
hints: À quoi l'engrais aide-t-il généralement une plante ?
fr.worked_example: Pense à ce que tu sais déjà. Dis ta meilleure hypothèse, et pourquoi.

feedback.correct: La plante avec engrais pourrait mieux grandir - une prédiction bien raisonnée. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Pense à ce que l'engrais aide généralement une plante à faire, puis dis ta prédiction.
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: La plante avec engrais pourrait devenir plus grande ou plus saine que l'autre.

pt.instruction: Diga o que você prevê que vai acontecer.
pt.prompt: Um cientista adiciona um fertilizante especial em apenas uma de duas plantas idênticas.
hints: Para que o fertilizante geralmente ajuda uma planta?
pt.worked_example: Pense no que você já sabe. Diga seu melhor palpite, e por quê.

feedback.correct: A planta fertilizada pode crescer melhor - uma previsão bem fundamentada. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Pense para que o fertilizante geralmente ajuda uma planta, depois diga sua previsão.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: A planta fertilizada pode crescer mais alta ou mais saudável do que a outra.

it.instruction: Dì cosa prevedi che accadrà.
it.prompt: Uno scienziato aggiunge del fertilizzante speciale solo a una delle due piante identiche.
hints: A cosa serve di solito il fertilizzante per aiutare una pianta?
it.worked_example: Pensa a quello che già sai. Dì la tua ipotesi migliore, e perché.

feedback.correct: La pianta fertilizzata potrebbe crescere meglio - una previsione ben ragionata. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Pensa a cosa serve di solito il fertilizzante per aiutare una pianta, poi dì la tua previsione.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come funziona.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: La pianta fertilizzata potrebbe crescere più alta o più sana dell'altra.

de.instruction: Sag, was du vorhersagst, dass passieren wird.
de.prompt: Ein Wissenschaftler gibt nur einer von zwei gleichen Pflanzen speziellen Dünger.

feedback.correct: Die gedüngte Pflanze könnte besser wachsen – eine gut begründete Vorhersage. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Denk darüber nach, wobei Dünger einer Pflanze normalerweise helfen soll, und sag dann deine Vorhersage.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

hints: Senza nulla che controlli il suo numero, cosa succede di solito a una popolazione?
it.worked_example: Pensa a quello che già sai. Dì la tua ipotesi migliore, e perché.

feedback.correct: Potrebbe diffondersi ampiamente - una previsione davvero attenta e avanzata. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Pensa a cosa succede di solito a una popolazione quando nulla controlla il suo numero.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come funziona.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Potrebbe crescere molto velocemente e diffondersi ampiamente senza nulla che la controlli.

de.instruction: Sag, was du vorhersagst, dass passieren wird.
de.prompt: Eine neue Pflanzenart wird versehentlich auf eine Insel gebracht, auf der es keine natürlichen Fressfeinde für sie gibt.
hints: Was passiert normalerweise mit einer Population, wenn nichts ihre Anzahl begrenzt?
de.worked_example: Denk an das, was du schon weißt. Sag deine beste Vermutung, und warum.

feedback.correct: Sie könnte sich weit verbreiten – eine wirklich sorgfältige, fortgeschrittene Vorhersage. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Denk darüber nach, was normalerweise mit einer Population passiert, wenn nichts ihre Anzahl begrenzt.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Sie könnte sich sehr schnell vermehren und weit ausbreiten, wenn nichts sie begrenzt.

nl.instruction: Zeg wat je voorspelt dat er gaat gebeuren.
nl.prompt: Een nieuwe plantensoort wordt per ongeluk geïntroduceerd op een eiland zonder natuurlijke vijanden ervoor.
hints: Zonder iets dat de aantallen controleert, wat gebeurt er meestal met een populatie?
nl.worked_example: Denk aan wat je al weet. Zeg je beste gok, en waarom.

feedback.correct: Hij zou zich wijd kunnen verspreiden - een echt zorgvuldige, geavanceerde voorspelling. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Denk aan wat er meestal gebeurt met een populatie als niets de aantallen controleert.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Hij zou heel snel kunnen groeien en zich wijd verspreiden zonder dat iets hem controleert.

ru.instruction: Скажи, что, по-твоему, произойдёт.
ru.prompt: Новый вид растения случайно попадает на остров, где у него нет природных хищников.
hints: Что обычно происходит с популяцией, если ничто не ограничивает её численность?
ru.worked_example: Подумай о том, что ты уже знаешь. Скажи свою лучшую догадку и почему.

feedback.correct: Оно может широко распространиться — по-настоящему продуманное, продвинутое предсказание. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Подумай, что обычно происходит с популяцией, когда ничто не ограничивает её численность.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Оно может очень быстро разрастись и широко распространиться, потому что ничто его не ограничивает.

tr.prompt: Yeni bir bitki türü, onun için doğal yırtıcısı olmayan bir adaya kazara getiriliyor.
hints: Sayısını kontrol eden hiçbir şey olmadan, bir popülasyona genellikle ne olur?
tr.worked_example: Zaten bildiğin şeyi düşün. En iyi tahminini ve nedenini söyle.

feedback.correct: Geniş çapta yayılabilir - gerçekten dikkatli, ileri düzey bir tahmin. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Sayısını kontrol eden hiçbir şey olmadığında bir popülasyona genellikle ne olduğunu düşün.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Onu kontrol eden hiçbir şey olmadan çok hızlı büyüyebilir ve geniş çapta yayılabilir.

zh.instruction: 说一说你预测会发生什么。
zh.prompt: 一个新的植物物种被意外引入到一个没有天敌的岛上。
hints: 没有任何东西控制它的数量,一个种群通常会发生什么?
zh.worked_example: 想一想你已经知道的知识。说出你最好的猜测,以及原因。

feedback.correct: 它可能会广泛蔓延——这是一个真正谨慎、进阶的预测。🌿
feedback.incorrect: 想一想当没有任何东西控制数量时,一个种群通常会发生什么。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 由于没有任何控制,它可能会迅速增长并广泛蔓延。

ja.instruction: 何が起こるか予想して言おう。
ja.prompt: 新しい植物の種類が、それを食べる天敵がいない島に、うっかり持ち込まれる。
hints: 数を抑えるものが何もないとき、ふつう生物の数はどうなる?
ja.worked_example: すでに知っていることを考えよう。一番良さそうな予想と、その理由を言おう。

feedback.correct: 広く広がるかもしれないよ。本当によく考えられた、高度な予想だね。🌿
feedback.incorrect: 数を抑えるものが何もないとき、生物の数がふつうどうなるか考えよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 抑えるものが何もないから、とても速く増えて、広く広がるかもしれないよ。

ko.instruction: 무엇이 일어날지 예측해서 말해보세요.
ko.prompt: 새로운 식물 종이 천적이 전혀 없는 섬에 우연히 들어옵니다.
hints: 개체 수를 조절하는 것이 전혀 없다면, 보통 그 개체군에 무슨 일이 일어날까요?
ko.worked_example: 이미 알고 있는 것을 생각해보세요. 가장 그럴듯한 추측과 그 이유를 말해보세요.

feedback.correct: 널리 퍼질 수도 있어요 - 정말 신중하고 수준 높은 예측이에요. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: 개체 수를 조절하는 것이 없을 때 개체군에 보통 무슨 일이 일어나는지 생각해보세요.
feedback.second_try: 함께 해볼까요 - 어떻게 하는지 지켜보세요.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 조절할 것이 없으니 아주 빠르게 자라서 널리 퍼질 수도 있어요.

id.instruction: Ucapkan apa yang menurutmu akan terjadi.
id.prompt: Sebuah spesies tumbuhan baru secara tidak sengaja dibawa ke sebuah pulau yang tidak memiliki predator alami untuknya.
hints: Tanpa ada yang mengendalikan jumlahnya, apa yang biasanya terjadi pada sebuah populasi?
id.worked_example: Pikirkan apa yang sudah kamu ketahui. Ucapkan tebakan terbaikmu, dan alasannya.

feedback.correct: Tumbuhan itu bisa menyebar luas - prediksi yang benar-benar cermat dan tingkat lanjut. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Pikirkan apa yang biasanya terjadi pada sebuah populasi ketika tidak ada yang mengendalikan jumlahnya.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Tumbuhan itu bisa tumbuh sangat cepat dan menyebar luas tanpa ada yang mengendalikannya.

vi.instruction: Nói điều bạn đoán sẽ xảy ra.
vi.prompt: Một loài cây mới vô tình được đưa đến một hòn đảo không có kẻ thù tự nhiên nào cho nó.
hints: Khi không có gì kiểm soát số lượng, điều gì thường xảy ra với một quần thể?
vi.worked_example: Nghĩ về điều bạn đã biết. Nói ra dự đoán tốt nhất của bạn, và vì sao.

feedback.correct: Nó có thể lan rộng ra - một dự đoán cẩn thận, nâng cao thực sự. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Nghĩ xem điều gì thường xảy ra với một quần thể khi không có gì kiểm soát số lượng của nó.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Nó có thể phát triển rất nhanh và lan rộng ra khi không có gì kiểm soát nó.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Say what you predict will happen.
questions.prompt: Two identical plants - one watered daily, one watered only once a week.
hints: Which plant is getting closer to what it needs to thrive?
questions.worked_example: Think about what you already know. Say your best guess, and why.

feedback.correct: The daily-watered plant is likely healthier - a well-reasoned, comparative prediction. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Think about which watering schedule is closer to what a plant actually needs.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.hidden_lesson: A fair test like this, changing only watering, gives a genuinely trustworthy result.

analysis.primary_construct: using existing knowledge to predict an outcome aloud
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Oral prediction removes the writing barrier, revealing predictive reasoning independent of literacy skill.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A prediction given with no reasoning attached shows the idea is there but the justification habit isn't yet.
analysis.parent_note: Ask why after any prediction, gently and often - it builds this exact reasoning muscle.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Predict outcomes together before checking, during any hands-on activity.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: The daily-watered plant will likely be healthier or bigger, because it's getting closer to what it needs.

es.instruction: Di qué predices que va a pasar.
es.prompt: Dos plantas idénticas - una se riega todos los días, la otra solo una vez a la semana.
hints: ¿Qué planta se acerca más a lo que necesita para prosperar?
es.worked_example: Piensa en lo que ya sabes. Di tu mejor suposición, y por qué.

feedback.correct: La planta regada a diario probablemente esté más sana - una predicción comparativa bien razonada. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Piensa en qué horario de riego se acerca más a lo que una planta realmente necesita.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: La planta regada a diario probablemente esté más sana o más grande, porque se acerca más a lo que necesita.

fr.instruction: Dis ce que tu penses qu'il va se passer.
fr.prompt: Deux plantes identiques - l'une arrosée chaque jour, l'autre arrosée seulement une fois par semaine.
hints: Laquelle des deux plantes se rapproche le plus de ce dont elle a besoin pour bien se développer ?
fr.worked_example: Pense à ce que tu sais déjà. Dis ta meilleure hypothèse, et pourquoi.

feedback.correct: La plante arrosée chaque jour est probablement plus saine - une prédiction comparative bien raisonnée. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Pense à quel rythme d'arrosage se rapproche le plus de ce dont une plante a vraiment besoin.
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: La plante arrosée chaque jour sera probablement plus saine ou plus grande, parce qu'elle reçoit ce dont elle a besoin.

pt.instruction: Diga o que você prevê que vai acontecer.
pt.prompt: Duas plantas idênticas - uma regada todo dia, outra regada só uma vez por semana.
hints: Qual planta está chegando mais perto do que precisa para prosperar?
pt.worked_example: Pense no que você já sabe. Diga seu melhor palpite, e por quê.

feedback.correct: A planta regada todo dia provavelmente está mais saudável - uma previsão comparativa bem fundamentada. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Pense em qual rotina de rega está mais perto do que uma planta realmente precisa.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: A planta regada todo dia provavelmente vai estar mais saudável ou maior, porque está mais perto do que ela precisa.

it.instruction: Dì cosa prevedi che accadrà.
it.prompt: Due piante identiche - una bagnata ogni giorno, una bagnata solo una volta a settimana.
hints: Quale pianta si avvicina di più a quello di cui ha bisogno per crescere bene?
it.worked_example: Pensa a quello che già sai. Dì la tua ipotesi migliore, e perché.

feedback.correct: La pianta bagnata ogni giorno è probabilmente più sana - una previsione ben ragionata e comparativa. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Pensa a quale programma di irrigazione si avvicina di più a quello di cui una pianta ha davvero bisogno.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come funziona.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: La pianta bagnata ogni giorno sarà probabilmente più sana o più grande, perché si avvicina a quello di cui ha bisogno.

de.instruction: Sag, was du vorhersagst, dass passieren wird.
de.prompt: Zwei gleiche Pflanzen – eine wird täglich gegossen, die andere nur einmal pro Woche.
hints: Welche Pflanze bekommt eher das, was sie zum Gedeihen braucht?
de.worked_example: Denk an das, was du schon weißt. Sag deine beste Vermutung, und warum.

feedback.correct: Die täglich gegossene Pflanze ist wahrscheinlich gesünder – eine gut begründete, vergleichende Vorhersage. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Denk darüber nach, welcher Gießplan eher dem entspricht, was eine Pflanze tatsächlich braucht.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Die täglich gegossene Pflanze wird wahrscheinlich gesünder oder größer sein, weil sie eher das bekommt, was sie braucht.

nl.instruction: Zeg wat je voorspelt dat er gaat gebeuren.
nl.prompt: Twee identieke planten - één elke dag water gegeven, één maar één keer per week.
hints: Welke plant komt dichter bij wat hij nodig heeft om te gedijen?
nl.worked_example: Denk aan wat je al weet. Zeg je beste gok, en waarom.

feedback.correct: De dagelijks begoten plant is waarschijnlijk gezonder - een goed beredeneerde, vergelijkende voorspelling. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Denk aan welk bewateringsschema dichter bij komt wat een plant echt nodig heeft.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: De dagelijks begoten plant zal waarschijnlijk gezonder of groter zijn, omdat hij dichter bij krijgt wat hij nodig heeft.

ru.instruction: Скажи, что, по-твоему, произойдёт.
ru.prompt: Два одинаковых растения — одно поливают каждый день, другое — только раз в неделю.
hints: Какое растение получает больше того, что нужно ему для процветания?
ru.worked_example: Подумай о том, что ты уже знаешь. Скажи свою лучшую догадку и почему.

feedback.correct: Растение, которое поливают каждый день, вероятно, здоровее — хорошо обоснованное, сравнительное предсказание. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Подумай, какой график полива ближе к тому, что растению действительно нужно.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Растение, которое поливают каждый день, вероятно, будет здоровее или больше, потому что оно получает больше того, что ему нужно.

tr.prompt: İki aynı bitki - biri her gün, biri sadece haftada bir sulanıyor.
hints: Hangi bitki, gelişmek için ihtiyacı olana daha yakın?
tr.worked_example: Zaten bildiğin şeyi düşün. En iyi tahminini ve nedenini söyle.

feedback.correct: Her gün sulanan bitki muhtemelen daha sağlıklı - iyi akıl yürütülmüş, karşılaştırmalı bir tahmin. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Hangi sulama programının bir bitkinin gerçekte ihtiyacına daha yakın olduğunu düşün.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Her gün sulanan bitki muhtemelen daha sağlıklı veya daha büyük olacak, çünkü ihtiyacına daha yakın.

zh.instruction: 说一说你预测会发生什么。
zh.prompt: 两株完全一样的植物——一株每天浇水,一株只每周浇水一次。
hints: 哪一株植物更接近它茂盛生长所需要的条件?
zh.worked_example: 想一想你已经知道的知识。说出你最好的猜测,以及原因。

feedback.correct: 每天浇水的那株植物可能更健康——这是一个推理合理的比较性预测。🌱
feedback.incorrect: 想一想哪种浇水方式更接近植物真正需要的条件。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 每天浇水的那株植物可能会更健康或更大,因为它更接近自己需要的条件。

ja.instruction: 何が起こるか予想して言おう。
ja.prompt: 同じ植物2つ。1つは毎日水をやり、もう1つは週に1回だけ水をやる。
hints: どちらの植物が、元気に育つために必要なものに近づいている?
ja.worked_example: すでに知っていることを考えよう。一番良さそうな予想と、その理由を言おう。

feedback.correct: 毎日水をもらう植物の方が、たぶん健康だよ。よく考えられた、比べる予想だね。🌱
feedback.incorrect: どちらの水やりの方法が、植物に本当に必要なものに近いか考えよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 毎日水をもらう植物の方が、必要なものに近いから、たぶん健康か大きく育つよ。

ko.instruction: 무엇이 일어날지 예측해서 말해보세요.
ko.prompt: 똑같은 식물 두 개 - 하나는 매일 물을 주고, 하나는 일주일에 한 번만 물을 줍니다.
hints: 어느 식물이 잘 자라는 데 필요한 것에 더 가까울까요?
ko.worked_example: 이미 알고 있는 것을 생각해보세요. 가장 그럴듯한 추측과 그 이유를 말해보세요.

feedback.correct: 매일 물을 준 식물이 더 건강할 가능성이 높아요 - 잘 추론한 비교 예측이에요. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: 어느 물주기 방식이 식물에게 실제로 필요한 것에 더 가까운지 생각해보세요.
feedback.second_try: 함께 해볼까요 - 어떻게 하는지 지켜보세요.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 필요한 것에 더 가까우니 매일 물을 준 식물이 더 건강하거나 더 크게 자랄 가능성이 높아요.

id.instruction: Ucapkan apa yang menurutmu akan terjadi.
id.prompt: Dua tumbuhan yang identik - satu disiram setiap hari, satu hanya disiram sekali seminggu.
hints: Tumbuhan mana yang lebih mendekati apa yang dibutuhkannya untuk tumbuh subur?
id.worked_example: Pikirkan apa yang sudah kamu ketahui. Ucapkan tebakan terbaikmu, dan alasannya.

feedback.correct: Tumbuhan yang disiram setiap hari kemungkinan lebih sehat - prediksi perbandingan yang beralasan dengan baik. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Pikirkan jadwal penyiraman mana yang lebih mendekati apa yang sebenarnya dibutuhkan tumbuhan.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Tumbuhan yang disiram setiap hari kemungkinan akan lebih sehat atau lebih besar, karena lebih mendekati apa yang dibutuhkannya.

vi.instruction: Nói điều bạn đoán sẽ xảy ra.
vi.prompt: Hai cây giống nhau - một được tưới nước mỗi ngày, một chỉ được tưới một lần mỗi tuần.
hints: Cây nào đang được đáp ứng gần hơn với điều nó cần để phát triển tốt?
vi.worked_example: Nghĩ về điều bạn đã biết. Nói ra dự đoán tốt nhất của bạn, và vì sao.

feedback.correct: Cây được tưới mỗi ngày có thể sẽ khỏe hơn - một dự đoán so sánh có lý do rõ ràng. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Nghĩ xem lịch tưới nước nào gần hơn với điều cây thực sự cần.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Cây được tưới mỗi ngày có thể sẽ khỏe hơn hoặc lớn hơn, vì nó được đáp ứng gần hơn với điều nó cần.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain what would happen, and why.
questions.prompt: Why does ice melt in a warm room?
hints: Say what happens, then say why.
questions.worked_example: Say what happens first. Then add one because.

feedback.correct: A clear explanation with both the effect and the reason. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Say what happens to ice, then explain why it happens.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Melting doesn't make something disappear - it just changes its state.

analysis.primary_construct: verbalising both an effect and the underlying reason for it
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: A step beyond simple prediction - explaining the mechanism, not just the outcome.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Stating an effect correctly with no explanation of why shows the fact, not the mechanism, is known.
analysis.parent_note: Explaining why, not just what, is where deeper science understanding shows itself.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask 'why does that happen' after sharing any cause-and-effect fact.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Because warmth changes ice from solid back into liquid water.

es.instruction: Explica qué pasaría, y por qué.
es.prompt: ¿Por qué se derrite el hielo en una habitación cálida?
hints: Di qué pasa, y luego di por qué.
es.worked_example: Di primero qué pasa. Luego añade un porqué.

feedback.correct: Una explicación clara, con el efecto y la razón. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Di qué le pasa al hielo, y luego explica por qué pasa.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Porque el calor convierte el hielo, de sólido, otra vez en agua líquida.

fr.instruction: Explique ce qui se passerait, et pourquoi.
fr.prompt: Pourquoi la glace fond-elle dans une pièce chaude ?
hints: Dis ce qui se passe, puis dis pourquoi.
